claims.title: Certainty and applicability are claim-specific
claims.proposition: Evidence certainty and applicability must be assessed for a specific proposition, outcome, population and context; a prestigious source does not make every possible inference high-certainty.

appraisal.rationale: Strong methodological consensus, adapted cautiously from evidence-based decision frameworks to StayOpti.

requiredConditions: a Library claim is being appraised or applied

effects.effectSummary: Claim certainty and directness constrain permitted policy effects.
effects.prohibitedUniversalization: Do not transfer an effect beyond the studied/appraised scope without an indirectness penalty.

biasAndFairnessNotes: Evidence-rich populations and markets must not become silent defaults for under-studied groups.
counterfactualTemplates: If direct evidence for this traveler/trip context is unavailable, the claim becomes an indirect weak prior or is inapplicable.

claims.title: Generated language must remain downstream of deterministic evidence
claims.proposition: A generated explanation may rewrite verified decision reasons but must not create new facts, evidence, preferences or causal explanations.

appraisal.rationale: Official AI risk guidance emphasizes validity, provenance, transparency and information integrity.

effects.prohibitedUniversalization: A fluent statement is not evidence.

biasAndFairnessNotes: Generated prose can amplify cultural stereotypes or hide uncertainty if not evidence-bound.
counterfactualTemplates: If a sentence cannot be traced to evidence and a reason code, remove it or label it as unavailable.

claims.title: Star category is a scoped service-expectation prior, not universal experienced quality
claims.proposition: An official star category can inform expected facilities and services only when the classification system and validity are known; it cannot by itself establish experienced quality or a universal premium across markets.

appraisal.rationale: Official criteria directly define facilities/service expectations in member systems, but satisfaction and cross-system equivalence require separate evidence.

requiredConditions: category provenance and validity are observed

effects.effectSummary: Set category-relative service expectations and peer-group eligibility.
effects.prohibitedUniversalization: Never equate one additional star with a fixed experienced-quality gain.

biasAndFairnessNotes: Classification systems may encode regional service conventions and do not capture every accessibility or experiential need.
counterfactualTemplates: If provenance is unknown, remove the category prior and rely on observed room/service/review evidence with lower confidence.

claims.title: Declared accessibility needs are verified hard-fit requirements
claims.proposition: When a traveler declares an accessibility need, relevant property, route and information features must be verified; missing evidence cannot be treated as compliance and should block recommendation or trigger abstention.

appraisal.rationale: International standard and UN Tourism guidance treat accessibility as end-to-end requirements, not optional generic comfort.

requiredConditions: a relevant access need is declared

effects.effectSummary: A verified mismatch is ineligible; unresolved material evidence triggers abstention.
effects.prohibitedUniversalization: Do not assume one accessibility label satisfies all individual needs.

nonApplicabilityReasons: no access requirement is declared or relevant
biasAndFairnessNotes: Generic amenity flags often underdescribe dimensions of accessibility; user-controlled requirement detail is essential.
counterfactualTemplates: The option becomes eligible only when every declared requirement is verified for the property and relevant route.

claims.title: Decision presentation must remain perceivable, operable, understandable and robust
claims.proposition: StayOpti's interaction and explanation surfaces must meet current accessibility requirements and be verified with both technical and human evaluation.

appraisal.rationale: WCAG supplies testable requirements; legal scope is recorded separately.

requiredConditions: a public or evaluator-facing interface is rendered

effects.effectSummary: Block public eligibility when accessibility gates fail.
effects.prohibitedUniversalization: Automated conformance checks do not cover every user need.

biasAndFairnessNotes: Include people with varied disabilities in manual evaluation; do not optimize only for screen-reader automation.
counterfactualTemplates: Public eligibility resumes only after technical and human accessibility findings are resolved or transparently bounded.
